# Security Checklist: Access, Sharing, And Downloads

**Purpose**: Validate security, privacy, audit, and no-secret requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are meeting list, detail, share-link, download, and export resources covered by authenticated effective-access requirements? [Completeness, Spec FR-002/FR-006/FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 Are privacy-preserving denied/not-found requirements explicit enough to avoid leaking private titles, transcripts, summaries, participants, artifact state, or meeting existence? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are all forbidden secret classes documented for API/UI/logs/evidence: storage keys, signed URLs, credentials, bearer tokens, raw object paths, dependency IDs, and local paths? [Completeness, Spec FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 Are audit requirements defined for share grant, share revoke, share-link open, successful view, denied view, download, export, and policy-denied egress attempts? [Completeness, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Is fail-closed behavior specified for share/revoke/download/export when metadata-only audit cannot be recorded? [Clarity, Spec FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Are public links explicitly disabled by default and scoped out unless future workspace policy enables them? [Consistency, Spec FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Are server-owned egress requirements consistent with the rule that desktop clients never store server/dependency credentials? [Consistency, Spec FR-016, Constitution III]
- [x] CHK008 Are login-required share links consistent with unauthenticated users seeing no private meeting metadata before auth? [Consistency, Spec US2, FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Are audit metadata requirements consistent with no private content in logs, diagnostics, problem responses, screenshots, and tracked evidence? [Consistency, Spec FR-008/FR-012/SC-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK010 Can permitted, denied, revoked, unauthenticated, team-visible, shared, and unrelated-user states be objectively evaluated for both list and detail surfaces? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK011 Can the no-secret egress requirement be objectively evaluated across direct artifact routes, export routes, audit events, logs, and tracked screenshots? [Measurability, Spec SC-002/SC-005]
- [x] CHK012 Are policy-denied egress attempts included as first-class security evidence rather than only successful downloads/exports? [Coverage, Spec FR-008/SC-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK013 Are dependencies on existing auth, workspace membership, device context, Postgres, MinIO, and audit foundations documented rather than redefined silently? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions, Plan Technical Context]
- [x] CHK014 Are retention/deletion execution controls explicitly deferred while deletion-truth copy remains required for exported files? [Scope, Spec FR-013/FR-015]

## Notes

- Security checklist passes. The clarified audit-fail-closed rule removes the main ambiguity before task generation.
